# Third-party dependencies

## LLaMA-Factory (training framework)

`third_party/LLaMA-Factory/` is the locally kept training-framework checkout (excluded from Git) used for QLoRA training.

Local checkout information:

- Upstream: https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory
- Version: 0.9.5.108 (`tests/version.txt`), commit `cabe59a3`
- Local modifications:
  - registered the `cad_train` dataset in `data/dataset_info.json` (copied to
    `configs/llamafactory/dataset_info.json`);
  - `data/cad_train.json` is the training data (generated by `scripts/make_train_json.py`, not committed).

Fresh-environment installation:

```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory.git third_party/LLaMA-Factory
pip install -e "third_party/LLaMA-Factory[torch,bitsandbytes]"   # choose extras per the upstream docs
# dataset registration: see configs/llamafactory/README.md
```

## Other external repositories

- DeepCAD: data source; obtain the original data and conversion tools from its official repository.
- Open CASCADE (pythonocc-core): geometric reconstruction checks in the three-stage validation.
- Ollama: local inference service used for instructional reconstruction.
